quests.name: The Barkeep's Rat Problem
quests.description: The barkeep swears the rats on the Old Road are getting bigger. Two should settle it.
quests.completion: The barkeep nods slowly. 'Bigger than I remembered. Thank you.' He resumes polishing.

quests.name: Cheese Audit
quests.description: The Guild Recruiter needs one (1) wheel of cheese from the pantry to 'complete a vital onboarding funnel'. Bring it to him.
quests.completion: He accepts the cheese, weeps briefly, and hands you a 'Welcome Packet' that is just a ring of keys.

quests.name: Touch Grass
quests.description: You have been underground a concerning length of time. Go to the Old Road and stand in the sun.
quests.completion: The recruiter looks relieved on your behalf. Then he offers you a guild invite.

quests.name: Who Lit the Lantern?
quests.description: Something has been lighting lanterns down in the Sunken Crypt. Find it. Make it stop.
quests.completion: The light goes out. Somewhere far away, a very small bell rings.
